view.basis: Observed tail is close-only with unknown OHLC/volume, never fabricated complete candles. Missing source buckets are not forward-filled. Closed canonical provider bars replace overlapping observations.

stream.coverage: Yahoo public indicative last-price stream; latency and consolidated/NBBO coverage are not guaranteed. No tick is not proof of disconnection or zero price.
stream.continuity: Indicative last prices are not a complete trade tape. Reconnect gaps are not backfilled by snapshots.

numberEncoding: Non-finite values are null; inspect unbounded flags, incomplete bars and calculation status.
